route_decision.fallback_if_route_validation_fails: If Tushare cannot provide required PIT fields, restatement lineage, total-return inputs, or terminal delisting lineage, A-long remains blocked until the user approves a different provider/data purchase decision or a narrower long-lane design.

required_route_components.plain_need: Build the frozen monthly as-of schedule from real A-share open trading days.
required_route_components.storage_grain: one schedule artifact for 2018-01-31 through 2025-12-31 monthly last open trading day
required_route_components.validation_gate: Every registered as_of month must map to one open A-share trading day; missing months block the route.
required_route_components.if_missing: Do not infer month-end trading days from calendar dates; A-long stays blocked.

required_route_components.plain_need: Use a historical A-share universe that keeps names before delisting and excludes instruments not meant for A-long common-equity research.
required_route_components.storage_grain: raw stock_basic snapshots for list_status L/D/P plus per-as_of membership summary
required_route_components.validation_gate: For every as_of, membership must use list_date <= as_of and delist_date empty or > as_of; later delisted names must remain before delist_date.
required_route_components.if_missing: Do not use today's active list as history; A-long stays blocked.

required_route_components.plain_need: Store raw fundamentals with announcement dates before any long factor is derived.
required_route_components.storage_grain: raw rows by api_family / period_or_ann_date_window / retrieval timestamp; duplicates preserved
required_route_components.validation_gate: ann_date must exist for PIT-usable rows; ann_date > as_of is zero-tolerance look-ahead; missing or invalid ann_date rows are excluded and reported.
required_route_components.if_missing: Do not substitute A-short financial_*.pkl derived values; A-long stays blocked.

required_route_components.plain_need: Preserve enough raw rows to prove later restatements are not used before they were announced.
required_route_components.storage_grain: all rows for each ts_code + end_date group, not post-deduped latest-only values
required_route_components.validation_gate: For duplicate ts_code + end_date groups, the future audit must select only the latest ann_date <= as_of and flag any latest-only ambiguity.
required_route_components.if_missing: Classify required factor fields as latest-only / not PIT-certified and keep A-long blocked or narrow the future factor set under review.

required_route_components.plain_need: Support SW L2 normalization without replaying today's industry assignment into the past.
required_route_components.storage_grain: SW L1/L2 classification plus historical membership rows with effective intervals
required_route_components.validation_gate: Each symbol used for industry normalization must have an as-of-valid SW L2 or an explicit SW L1 fallback reason.
required_route_components.if_missing: Do not run SW-normalized long factors; either use a reviewed fallback design or keep A-long signal search blocked.

required_route_components.plain_need: Measure long returns and benchmark excess on the same anchors with reviewed total-return treatment.
required_route_components.storage_grain: daily stock price/adj rows, dividend rows, and benchmark open/close rows over the declared usable window
required_route_components.validation_gate: Stock entry/exit and benchmark entry/exit must use the same anchors; qfq via adj_factor and dividend treatment must be documented without double-counting.
required_route_components.if_missing: Do not call price-only adjusted returns total-return evidence; A-long stays blocked for alpha search.

required_route_components.plain_need: If a held name delists or stops trading during the holding window, the return leg must eat that outcome rather than dropping the row.
required_route_components.storage_grain: per-held-symbol terminal-outcome record whenever membership or price rows end inside a holding window
required_route_components.validation_gate: The future audit must fail if a delisting/no-trade terminal event is missing from survivorship or return measurement.
required_route_components.if_missing: Do not drop the position or fill the missing terminal return with 0; A-long stays blocked.

next_execution_packet_boundary.allowed_budget_shape: Small fixed route-validation packet only: exact symbols, exact periods/date windows, exact api families, zero alpha calculation, and reviewed call budget must be written before execution.

next_steps: Independent review must verify this route plan before any Tushare route-validation packet is created.
After review and a user execute command, create a separate small Tushare route-validation execution packet that confirms field presence and raw storage shape only.
If route validation passes, create a separate reviewed incremental materialization packet before any full 2018-2025 data pull.
After materialized data exists, create a new reviewed data-integrity audit authorization; do not rerun the spent audit blindly.
Only if the new audit passes hard checks and declares a usable start year may A-long signal-search preregistration be created.
limitations: This artifact defines the data route; it does not execute it.
This artifact does not call Tushare, read raw provider data, parse raw rows, create DataHub tables, change runners, or rerun the audit.
Tushare route feasibility is not proven until a reviewed route-validation packet executes and records a no-secret summary.
A pass of route validation would only allow data materialization planning, not alpha search.
A-long remains blocked for signal search until a new reviewed data-integrity audit passes.
